reference.title: Reference

returns.clean: Return a dictionary of table names to DataFrames. Table names use lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Without script 1, the flattened tables are the clean data.
returns.output: Return a dictionary of table names to DataFrames: the tables the clean data dashboard shows. Without script 2, it shows the clean tables.
returns.indicator: Return one DataFrame: the columns to break the figure down by (dimensions) and at least one numeric column. By convention value is what a widget plots by default, and numerator and denominator let it plot a rate as a ratio of sums.

parameters.clean: raw: a dictionary of the flattened tables, "main" and one per repeat group. Select answers are choice labels.
parameters.output: cleaned: a dictionary of the tables script 1 returned (or the flattened tables).
parameters.indicator: cleaned: a dictionary of the tables script 1 returned (or the flattened tables).

guide.heading: How to organize a file
guide.intro: One column per dimension and a target column, with one row per combination of values. For example:
guide.example: Example of a sampling frame file
guide.columns: Name each dimension column as you like, and fill it with the choice codes the form stores (such as 05001), not their labels.
guide.target: The column named target holds the surveys planned for each row: a whole number from 0 to {{ max }}.
guide.rows: Write each combination of values on its own row, and only once.
guide.emptyTarget: A row whose target is empty is left out, so rows you do not plan can stay in the file. A target of 0 keeps the row.
guide.notes: Columns whose name starts with # are notes, such as the labels next to the codes. They are not read.
guide.text: Keep codes such as 05001 as text, or the spreadsheet drops the leading zero.
guide.formats: Save the file as XLSX (only the first sheet is read) or as CSV in UTF-8, separated by commas or semicolons.
guide.limits: At most {{ questions }} dimensions, {{ rows }} rows and {{ size }} MB.
guide.templateLink: Get a template with your form's codes
